\emph{Equal-budget control.} Selected over the same 6-point $\beta$ grid as every other bottleneck at a single globally fixed anchor scale $a=16$ (a post-hoc sensitivity control), FGIB's mean rank is 2.33 of 7 (vs.\ 1.75 over the full $6\times9$ grid) and it is best or tied-best on 6 of 12 settings (vs.\ 7).
